name: @arnobot/storage
description: Arnobot PMS storage service: the PostgreSQL database (schema, migrations, seed) and the S3 video bucket. The backend server only connects to them.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:create && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:reset: tsx --env-file=.env src/cli/reset-db.ts --confirm && npm run db:create && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
